Character: A young woman, lean and quick, with a high dark ponytail tied off in a red band and loose bangs falling either side of the brow. A wide red sash at the waist with a small bronze disc buckle and two long trailing tails, over charcoal-black coat tails with gold-edged red panels. Feet at 85% of each cell height, heads never cropped, wide empty space between figures, no parts cross cell boundaries. Flat 2-tone cel shading, simple uniform dark-brown #1b1410 ink outlines, hand-drawn animated-series finish, red #d1462f and charcoal with gold trim. Background EXACT SOLID #00ff00 green in ALL empty pixels, no ground shadows, no cast shadows, no gradients, no text or labels, no grid lines, no panels or borders. No flames bigger than a hand. Match reference costume and face in all six poses.
